methodological_rigor.justification: Solid HNSCC study with comprehensive multi-method validation including in vitro assays, western blotting, co-IP, ubiquitination assays, and in vivo xenograft models with appropriate statistical tests (two-way ANOVA, t-test, Wilcoxon) and reported p-values and 95% CI. Minor limitations include single-center tissue samples and limited cell line diversity, acknowledged by authors. Rescue experiments effectively strengthen mechanistic conclusions.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Individual cohort study identifying CAV2/PACT/PKR axis as actionable drug-resistance mechanism in HNSCC. Xenograft CDI=0.501 demonstrates synergistic Cetuximab sensitization (6-fold IC50 reduction). Direct translational path to combination therapy trials with strong clinical implications for overcoming EGFR-targeted therapy resistance.

reporting_quality.justification: Comprehensive STROBE-aligned reporting with detailed methods (2.1-2.19), sample characteristics, assay protocols, antibody catalog numbers, and statistical approaches. Minor gaps include TCGA database redactions and incomplete supplementary content detail. No explicit data availability statement provided despite reference to public datasets and tissues.

novelty_literature.justification: Novel discovery of CAV2's specific role in HNSCC Cetuximab resistance via ubiquitin-mediated PACT/PKR degradation. While CAV2 studied in lung/pancreatic cancer, its functional mechanism in HNSCC and connection to E3-ligase-mediated drug resistance appears original. Mechanistic link between caveolin scaffolding and therapeutic resistance fills documented gap.

writing_presentation.justification: Well-organized manuscript with clear logic flow and good figure quality (Western blots, colony assays, tumor measurements legible). Methods comprehensively detailed. Discussion effectively integrates findings with literature and acknowledges limitations including single cell line toxicity, multifactorial resistance, and need for prospective validation. Minor redundancy in Results descriptions.

key_strengths: Comprehensive multi-omics integration (RNA-seq, proteomics) with validation in dual HNSCC cell lines
Multi-method rescue experiments confirming PACT/PKR as functional mediators downstream of CAV2
Orthotopic tongue xenograft model with bioluminescence imaging and synergistic drug interaction validation (CDI=0.501)
Strong prognostic correlation in TCGA cohort (95% CI 1.197–1.7518, p=1.33×10−13) supporting clinical relevance
Clear mechanistic model identifying ubiquitin-proteasome pathway as CAV2-mediated degradation mechanism
key_concerns: Limited to two HNSCC cell lines (SCC15, SCC25) with noted FaDu lentiviral toxicity suggesting mechanism may not generalize broadly
SMURF1 interaction with CAV2-PACT/PKR validated only computationally; direct physical interaction remains unproven
No testing in acquired Cetuximab-resistant models, only baseline-sensitive parental lines
Tissue samples from single center (Tianjin Medical University) limiting geographic generalization
Lacks human biomarker validation data and patient-derived xenograft models for clinical translation
chief_reviewer.rationale: Solid translational research with rigorous mechanistic evidence for CAV2-driven Cetuximab resistance positioned for clinical development. Requires human biomarker and prospective cohort validation before high-impact journal acceptance but demonstrates appropriate preclinical rigor and clear therapeutic potential.
